description: Lead periods per line of business (E7). lead-service resolves this rule set when a lead is created and sets expires_at = createdAt + expiryDays; an unset or non-positive expiryDays refuses the create (fail closed). Resolved by domain LEAD_POLICY and the lead's lob: another line of business (e.g. MOTOR 30/60 days, E7) is its own document (ruleSetId LEAD.POLICY.<LOB>, same domain, scope.lob set); a lob with no document in force refuses the create.

sections: E7 every business value is configuration; LEAD.POLICY per lob: expiryDays
Engineering defaults: lead expiry LIFE 90 days (owner's ideal)
requirements: docs/au-bank-insurance-platform/requirements/brd-detailed/Exception_Handling_BRD_V1.0_CONTEXT.md section 8.8 and 24.7 row 7 (delete the rejected lead after five days as configured; audit retention to be confirmed)

governance.signatureStatus: AI-DRAFTED - mandatory content-owner approval outstanding (ADR-024 section 7)
openItems: expiryDays 90 for LIFE is the owner's stated ideal (E7); Rajal to confirm whether it counts from creation or from the last activity (implemented: from creation)

rejectedLeadDeletionDays is UNSET although Exception BRD section 8.8 says five days: section 24.7 row 7 leaves audit retention to be confirmed and lead_id is RET-7Y attribution (04-lead_lms.sql). Strict default (E9): nothing is deleted until Compliance and the DBA confirm retention
The Lead BRD (Lead_Module_BRD_Detailed_CONTEXT.md) names no other configurable lead period; the meeting window 08:00-20:00 (Table 22) is stated as fixed, not configurable
